data.key: Oath against the Wyrm ~ Dragon-Slaying Strike
data.name: Dragon-Slaying Strike
data.description: You become a conduit of holy power.  Your DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever you use smite evil and successfully strikes a dragon, the dragon is also subject to a single-target holy word (caster level %1). After the banishment effect and the damage from the attack are resolved, the smite immediately ends. In addition, whenever you use lay on hands to heal a creature, you heal the maximum possible amount.|DragonSlayingStrikeCL
